# Compatibility fixtures

`modes-four.txt` and `modes-five.txt` are sanitized service CLI replies captured
from the original Infinity-X four-mode HAL and the known five-mode payload in
the earlier live tests. They contain profile data only, no device identifiers.
`version-one.txt` and `hash-v1.txt` are synthetic wire-format fixtures from the
frozen stable AIDL V1 contract; live introspection has not yet been captured.
`panel-modes.txt` is a minimal synthetic fixture for the QDCM block parser.
New LineageOS/crDroid installs are not claimed as tested by these fixtures.
